scope: Offline journey pack: real application routes and compiled Workflow with synthetic persistence/provider replies; phases use independent fixtures. This is not one continuous live-model/supplier purchase trace.
release_basis: Integrated source: PR25 e54c285da1927267a2758cc11b256caca2416aa2 plus PR24 69258fb5200981a6e9b6bff607ac629ecbf00eec; exact integration CI is recorded in the integration PR

assertions: retain destination, dates, party, origin, interests, budget and vibes
lost creation reply plus reload creates only one trip
untouched legacy brief preserves its revision and public link
dates/party, interests, pace, accessibility evidence, diet evidence, schedule gaps, budget units, price provenance, locks, purchase/reporting truth
scenarios.limit: Rubric calibration on hand-authored synthetic plans. No live model quality, venue accessibility, diet suitability, walking time, opening hours or supplier availability verified.

assertions: last accepted itinerary remains visible during failed reads
superseded compiled workflow stops before AI
confirmed save refreshes main trip despite editor refresh failure
canceled share explains that access remains public

scenarios.phase: Prevent stale checkout and require purchase consent
assertions: no outbound purchase action on stale brief
plan change during provider lookup prevents publication
already-open supplier page is outside application control
scenarios.limit: Hosted checkout UI/provider responses are mocked. No quote, inventory, reservation, payment or commission verified.

assertions: needed, opened-by-traveler and booked-by-traveler remain separate
verified booking is unavailable and cannot be self-selected
reports do not mutate affiliate conversions

acceptance_targets.live_model_quality: not measured; approval-gated evaluation remains required

execution.recovery: node ../../node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c playwright.recovery.config.ts (cwd apps/web, sanitized fixture environment)
execution.checkout: node ../../node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test -c playwright.checkout.config.ts (cwd apps/web, sanitized fixture environment)
